expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses memorization ('典型的记忆化症状：模型容量远超数据的信息量') and gives minimal fixes ordered by value: '加数据、去重——这是根本解', 'early stopping：盯 val loss，回升即停', 'dropout 0.1–0.2、weight decay 0.01–0.1'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: No concrete runnable command with expected output; answer ends with a request for info: '把数据量、参数量、训练步数和 train/val 两条 loss 曲线发出来，我可以帮你定位到具体环节。' Checks like 'len(set(texts))' are described abstractly with no command to run

expectations.text: B3: Identifies overfitting/memorization (tiny data, too many steps) and suggests a val set, more data, dropout or smaller model
expectations.evidence: Identifies overfitting/memorization ('纯记忆化', '小模型必然背下来；nanoGPT 在 Shakespeare…都会过拟合') and suggests val set ('划出 5–10% 数据做 val split'), more data ('加数据'), dropout ('dropout 0.1–0.2') and smaller model ('缩模型或加数据，让容量匹配数据规模')

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0), SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); only tool calls are two glob reads ('glob {"pattern": "**/*.py"}'), no install commands, nothing written outside the workspace
